Overview

Asenovgrad is a city in Plovdiv with a population of 50,590. A historic town near Plovdiv, known for the Asen’s Fortress, the Bachkovo Monastery, and its role as a center of Bulgarian Orthodox Christianity. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
